extraction_evidence.scope: Historical inspection of published v0.0.3 DMGs only; Windows 7-Zip extraction and static Mach-O inspection. This does not verify macOS signatures, execution, notarization, or identity against the original signed build. The overall review remains pending.
extraction_evidence.extraction: 7-Zip 26.06 DMG/HFS extraction of devcel-studio.app; check-native-distribution.py magic-byte inventory; llvm-objdump --macho --dylibs-used
extraction_evidence.observations: Each extracted app has exactly two Mach-O files (Studio and CLI); each CLI hash matches its own packaged manifest and its license equals the repository MIT CLI license. Both apps contain the same third-party notice aggregate. The inspected load commands name system frameworks and /usr/lib libraries; no non-system dynamic library path was observed. This does not establish that statically linked dependency notices are complete.

offline_signature_structure.scope: Published v0.0.3 DMGs only; independent offline consistency checks, not macOS codesign verification, identity verification or notarization.
offline_signature_structure.procedure: Parse each extracted thin Mach-O LC_CODE_SIGNATURE superblob and SHA-256 CodeDirectory. Recompute each covered code page; for both Studio binaries also compare the Info.plist and CodeResources special-slot hashes. Independently compare every CodeResources files2 SHA-256 entry against extracted bytes.
offline_signature_structure.outcome: All listed code-page hashes, both Studio special slots, and all ten CodeResources entries matched. Both CodeDirectories carry the ad-hoc-signature flag. This does not authenticate the publisher or prove that all redistributed dependency notices are complete.
